query: Impact gate: I'm adding a new nullable column promo_code (STRING) to the trips dataset that feeds our fare model.
expected_behavior: Classifies adding a nullable column as a non-breaking, additive change
Still computes the downstream blast radius with a skip-cache searchAcrossLineage query
Finds the downstream production model and resolves its owner
Returns a REVIEW verdict rather than an automatic PASS because a live downstream consumer exists and a human owner should sign off
Does not mutate any metadata and offers /datahub-quality for follow-up actions
